# BestPackFactory

> BestPackFactory is a Shenzhen-based B2B custom packaging supplier. The website helps buyers compare packaging formats, prepare RFQ specifications and request project-specific quotations. Standard MOQ begins at 500 PCS for supported custom projects.

## Core pages

- [Custom Packaging Products](https://www.bestpackfactory.com/products.html): Product categories and detailed specification pages.
- [Packaging Industries](https://www.bestpackfactory.com/industries.html): Guidance organized by buyer industry.
- [Packaging Materials](https://www.bestpackfactory.com/materials.html): Material selection references.
- [Printing and Finishes](https://www.bestpackfactory.com/finishes.html): Surface finish and decoration options.
- [Factory and Quality Control](https://www.bestpackfactory.com/factory.html): Production, sampling and QC information.
- [Quote-Ready Sourcing Hub](https://www.bestpackfactory.com/quote-ready-packaging-sourcing-hub.html): RFQ preparation and product routing.
- [Contact](https://www.bestpackfactory.com/contact.html): Send specifications and request a quotation.

## Main product categories

- [Custom Boxes](https://www.bestpackfactory.com/products/custom-boxes.html): Corrugated and paperboard structures for shipping and retail.
- [Flexible Packaging](https://www.bestpackfactory.com/products/flexible-packaging.html): Pouches, bags and printed film.
- [Coffee Bags](https://www.bestpackfactory.com/products/coffee-bags.html): Valve, zipper, flat-bottom and side-gusset formats.
- [Food Packaging](https://www.bestpackfactory.com/products/food-packaging.html): Project-specific food packaging formats and material selection.
- [Pet Food Bags](https://www.bestpackfactory.com/products/pet-food-bags.html): Barrier and resealable packaging for pet food and treats.
- [Pharma Packaging](https://www.bestpackfactory.com/products/pharma-packaging.html): Cartons, labels and containers requiring buyer-confirmed specifications.
- [Cannabis Mylar Bags](https://www.bestpackfactory.com/products/cannabis-mylar-bags.html): Custom pouches where legal and child-resistance requirements must be confirmed for the destination market.
- [Luxury Magnetic Boxes](https://www.bestpackfactory.com/products/luxury-magnetic-boxes.html): Rigid gift boxes with inserts and decorative finishes.

## Buyer information required for a quote

Provide packaging type, finished dimensions, quantity, product or fill weight, material preference, artwork status, printing and finish requirements, destination country and target delivery date. Material declarations, test reports and compliance documents vary by specification and must be confirmed before ordering.

## New buyer problem-solving guides (August 2026)

- [Custom Packaging Landed Cost Calculator: What Buyers Must Include](https://www.bestpackfactory.com/blog/custom-packaging-landed-cost-calculator-buyer-guide.html): Calculate the true landed cost of custom packaging by including tooling, printing, cartons, freight, duties, inspection and damage risk—not only unit price.
- [Low-MOQ Seasonal Packaging: A Hybrid Plan That Avoids Dead Stock](https://www.bestpackfactory.com/blog/low-moq-seasonal-packaging-hybrid-plan.html): A practical packaging system for seasonal launches: standard structures, variable labels, sleeves and inserts, with custom printing added after demand is proven.
- [Packaging Damage Root-Cause Checklist for Ecommerce Brands](https://www.bestpackfactory.com/blog/packaging-damage-root-cause-checklist-ecommerce.html): Diagnose ecommerce shipping damage by separating product movement, corner crush, puncture, moisture, seal failure and export-carton problems.
- [Dimensional Weight and Box Sizing: Stop Paying to Ship Air](https://www.bestpackfactory.com/blog/dimensional-weight-box-sizing-guide.html): A buyer-focused guide to reducing dimensional-weight exposure through right-sized boxes, inserts, export cartons and accurate packing data.
- [Coffee Bag Pinholes vs Degassing Valves: A Buyer Troubleshooting Guide](https://www.bestpackfactory.com/blog/coffee-bag-pinhole-vs-degassing-valve-troubleshooting.html): Learn why random pinholes are not a substitute for a one-way coffee valve and how to inspect film, seals, valve placement and packed-bag performance.
- [Skincare Packaging Box Inserts: How to Prevent Loose Bottles and Scuffed Cartons](https://www.bestpackfactory.com/blog/skincare-cosmetic-box-insert-fit-guide.html): Choose and validate paperboard, molded pulp, foam or thermoformed inserts for skincare bottles, jars, droppers and product kits.
- [Food Packaging Compliance Documents: What Buyers Should Request](https://www.bestpackfactory.com/blog/food-packaging-compliance-document-request-checklist.html): A practical checklist for requesting food-contact declarations, material identity, intended-use conditions, migration evidence and traceability documents.
- [Magnetic Gift Boxes: Flat-Pack vs Assembled for Global Shipping](https://www.bestpackfactory.com/blog/magnetic-gift-box-flat-pack-vs-assembled.html): Compare foldable magnetic boxes and assembled rigid boxes by freight volume, setup labor, corner quality, closure feel, storage and premium presentation.
- [Roll Label Winding Direction: The Checklist Before Automatic Application](https://www.bestpackfactory.com/blog/roll-label-winding-direction-application-checklist.html): Prevent roll-label application failures by confirming unwind direction, core size, roll diameter, label gap, copy position, sensor mark and liner.
- [Packaging Sample Color Approval: Avoiding Expensive Print Surprises](https://www.bestpackfactory.com/blog/packaging-sample-color-tolerance-approval-guide.html): A practical guide to approving digital proofs, wet proofs, substrates, Pantone targets, finishes, lighting and production color tolerance.

## Product specification quick facts

- MOQ: 500 PCS per custom size and artwork.
- Materials: kraft liner, white cardboard, corrugated board (E/B/BC flute), flexible films (PET/PE, aluminum foil laminates), recyclable paper options.
- Printing: offset, flexo (1-4 colors), full-color laminated offset for corrugated; digital proofing with Pantone matching support.
- Finishes: gloss, matte, soft-touch lamination, spot UV, foil stamping, embossing, debossing.
- Structures: mailer boxes, tuck-top boxes, auto-lock bottom, rigid boxes, magnetic closure, drawer boxes, paper bags (flat/square bottom, rope or ribbon handles), stand-up pouches (side gusset, flat bottom, K-seal), spout and zipper pouches.
- Sampling: dieline support and physical sampling available before production.
- QC: factory quality control with inspection options before shipment.
- Logistics: worldwide B2B export shipping; sea and air freight support.
- Quote inputs: packaging type, finished dimensions, quantity, product or fill weight, material preference, artwork status, printing and finish requirements, destination country, target delivery date.

## Frequently asked questions (short answers)

- What is your MOQ? 500 PCS per custom size and artwork.
- Do you support samples? Yes — dieline support and physical sampling are available before production.
- Which materials do you offer? Kraft liner, white cardboard, corrugated board, flexible films (PET/PE and aluminum laminates) and recyclable paper options.
- Can I get a custom size or structure? Yes — custom size, structure, printing and finishes are supported per project.
- What printing options are available? Offset and flexo printing from 1 to 4 colors, plus full-color laminated offset for corrugated, with Pantone matching support.
- What surface finishes do you offer? Gloss, matte and soft-touch lamination, spot UV, foil stamping, embossing and debossing.
- Do you ship worldwide? Yes — worldwide B2B export shipping by sea or air.
- What information do you need for a quote? Packaging type, finished dimensions, quantity, material preference, printing and finish requirements, destination country and target delivery date.
- Do you support our artwork? Yes — AI or print-ready PDF with vector logo and 3 mm bleed is recommended.
- How do I contact you? Email lisa@colorprintingpackage.com or WhatsApp +86 158 8653 0985.
